testConstruction: Last-known location is UNKNOWN and current voyage is NONE.
testRoutingStatus: Assigning an itinerary that fails the specification is MISROUTED.
Assigning an itinerary that satisfies the specification is ROUTED.

testCargoOnTrack: Expected RECEIVE, LOAD, UNLOAD and CLAIM events are accepted.
CUSTOMS does not affect expected-event matching.
Wrong location or voyage events are rejected.
testCreateItinerary: An empty leg list throws IllegalArgumentException.
A null leg list throws NullPointerException.

RouteSpecificationTest.testIsSatisfiedBySuccess: Matching origin/destination and an arrival before the deadline are accepted.
RouteSpecificationTest.testIsNotSatisfiedByWrongOrigin: An itinerary with the wrong first load location is rejected.
RouteSpecificationTest.testIsNotSatisfiedByWrongDestination: An itinerary with the wrong final unload location is rejected.
RouteSpecificationTest.testIsNotSatisfiedByMissedDeadline: Arrival after the deadline is rejected.

would_assert: New Hong Kong → Stockholm cargo is NOT_RECEIVED and NOT_ROUTED with no ETA/activity.
Assigning an itinerary changes routing status to ROUTED and sets ETA and next RECEIVE activity at Hong Kong.
The later handling lifecycle completes the cargo.
unexecuted_test_methods.note: The method has no @Test annotation and the class does not extend TestCase or declare a JUnit runner.

would_assert: Each candidate has a non-null, non-empty leg list.
The first leg starts at the route origin and the final leg ends at the route destination.
unexecuted_test_methods.note: The source method has no @Test annotation; these assertions are transcribed as a contract, not counted as executed source evidence.

testRegisterNew: Persists cargo with selected origin, destination and deadline.
Initial state is NOT_RECEIVED and NOT_ROUTED, with unknown location, no current voyage, no ETA/activity, no misdirection, and empty itinerary.
testRouteCandidates: Requests candidates for the registered tracking ID.
Asserts the candidate list is non-empty.
testAssignRoute: Cargo remains NOT_RECEIVED, is ROUTED, has ETA before deadline, and next activity is RECEIVE at origin.
testChangeDestination: Changes destination while preserving origin, deadline and assigned itinerary.
The old itinerary becomes MISROUTED and delivery ETA/activity reset.
testChangeDeadline: Changes deadline while preserving origin, destination and assigned itinerary.
The old itinerary becomes MISROUTED and delivery ETA/activity reset.
